title: Asking Permission to Borrow Something
paragraphs: Bekerja lembur suatu malam, Umar menyadari ia lupa membawa pengisi daya ponselnya sendiri dari rumah dan melihat pengisi daya rekan kerjanya tergeletak tidak terpakai di meja sebelah, tercolok dan bebas saat itu. Meski rekan kerjanya sudah pulang dan kemungkinan besar tidak akan keberatan, Umar memutuskan untuk mengirim pesan singkat meminta izin terlebih dahulu, alih-alih begitu saja mengambilnya tanpa mengatakan apa pun.

Rekan kerjanya membalas dalam semenit, memberi izin dengan senang hati dan menambahkan bahwa ia boleh memakainya kapan saja saat butuh mengisi daya ponsel di hari kerja yang sibuk. Umar mencolokkan ponselnya, merasa bahwa penundaan kecil untuk meminta izin dulu sepadan dengan ketenangan pikiran yang diberikannya, dibandingkan sekadar mengasumsikan izin yang sebenarnya belum diberikan.
answerKey: Working late one evening, Umar realizes he forgot his own charger at home and notices his coworker's charger sitting unused on the next desk, plugged in and free at that moment. Even though his coworker has already left for the day and would likely not mind, Umar decides to send a quick message asking permission first, rather than simply taking it without saying anything. His coworker replies within a minute, giving cheerful permission and adding that he was welcome to use it anytime he needed to charge his phone during a busy workday. Umar plugs in his phone, feeling that the small delay of asking first was worth the peace of mind it gave him, compared to simply assuming permission that had not actually been given yet.
